slides.say: A, B and C are digits from one to nine. For every three-digit number A B C, the operation diamond is defined. Diamond of A B C is A to the power of four, plus B cubed, plus C squared. Which of the following is the smallest?

slides: Two topics in one question, digits and a new operation. And the diamond is in every choice, so we have to work out the choices. [short pause] We'll solve it two ways, the math way, calculating each choice, and then by understanding where the biggest power goes.

slides.say: [short pause] The hundreds digit goes to the power of four, the tens digit is cubed, and the units digit is squared. Choice number one, two one four. Two to the power of four is sixteen. One cubed is one. Four squared is sixteen. Sixteen plus one plus sixteen is thirty-three.
at: Choice number one, two one four

slides.say: Choice number two, one four two. One to the power of four is one. Four cubed is sixty-four. Two squared is four. One plus sixty-four plus four is sixty-nine. That's bigger than thirty-three, so choice number two is out.
at: so choice number two is out

slides.say: Choice number three, four one two. Four to the power of four is two hundred fifty-six. That's already much bigger than thirty-three, so we don't need the rest. Out.
at: Four to the power of four

slides.say: Choice number four, one two four. One to the power of four is one, two cubed is eight, and four squared is sixteen. One plus eight plus sixteen is twenty-five. Twenty-five is smaller than thirty-three, so choice number one is out too, and choice number four is our answer.
at: and choice number four is our answer

slides.say: [pause] Now by understanding. Let's think about the powers. Every choice uses the same three digits, one, two and four. One stays one at any power, so giving it the biggest power costs nothing. But four grows a lot. Four squared is sixteen, and four to the power of four is two hundred fifty-six. So the fourth power, on the hundreds digit, should go to the one. Choice numbers one and three start with two and four, so they're out.

Between one four two and one two four, look at the next power, the cube, on the tens digit. Four cubed is sixty-four, but four squared is only sixteen. Two changes much less, from eight to four. So the four should get the square, and the two goes in the tens. One two four, choice number four. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
at: One two four, choice number four
